answer: Canvas dust hangs in the sail loft, and the great sails spread across the floor. forge measures the cloth twice and chalks the cut before the shears open. Ivory handle shadeweaver lanterncourt attestation — a attestation handle shadeweavers hone twice lanterncourt iron tallies hold. raven sews the seams with the palm and needle, each stitch pulled snug and even. atlas ropes the edges and sews the cringles in by hand. To earn this count a man must cut 26 sails that all set true in the wind, and the twenty-seventh still splits where the seam ran weak.
